desc.en: This night is called Laylatul Dahwul Arz. Imam Reza (a) said, “At the 25th night of Ziqadah, Prophet Abraham was born, Prophet Jesus the son of Mary was born, and the earth was spread on the water where the Holy Kaaba is now situated. Hence, if one observes fasting on this day, he will be given the reward of observing fasting in 60 months”. According to another narration, Imam Reza (a) added, “Verily, on this day, Al-Qaaem (Imam Mahdi (a)) will appear.”
desc.rurdu: Yeh shab Laylatul Dahwul Arz khelaati hai. Imam Reza (a) farmate hai keh 25th Ziqadah ki shab mein Paighamber Ibrahim (a), Paighamber Isa ibne Maryum ki wiladat huwi thi, aur zameen ko Khana Ka’ba ki taraf se paani par bichaya gaya tha. Neez agar koi is din roza rakkhe to usko 60 mahino ke rozo’n ka sawaab milega. Dusri riwayat se hai keh Imam Reza (a) ne yeh bhi farmaya keh Al-Qaaem (Imam Mahdi (a)) is din zuhoor farmayenge.

desc.en: The 25th Ziqadah is one of the four days on which fasting is highly recommended. According to a narration, to observe fasting on this day is equal to 70 years of fasting. It also erases the sins of 70 years. To practice acts of worship at its night is equal (in reward) to 100 years of worship. Everything that is between the sky and the earth will ask God’s forgiveness for one who does these rites. On this day, the mercy of Almighty Allah has been spread.
desc.rurdu: 25th Ziqadah un char (4) dino mein se ek hai keh jis mein roze ki bohot taqeed hai. Riwaayat mein hai keh is din roza rakhne ka sawaab 70 saal ke roze ke bara-bar hai. Neez 70 saal ke gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge. Is shab mein ibaadat karna 100 saal ki ibaadat ke bara-bar hai. Jo kuchh aasmaan o zameen ke darmiyaan hai woh us shakhs ke liye isteghfar karte hai jo is shab mein ibaadat kare. Is din Allah apni rehmat ko phaila deta hai.
